# Generated interface and field contract

Edit the annotated design, then run `oev2 design generate` and drift verification.


Design version: 2.0.0-rc.7.

Problem: 工程需求、语义模型、Rust 实现与验证缺少统一关系，持续升级可能偏离目标、证据或适用条件.

Purpose: 有条件地推进工程决定，保持升级前后的目标、语义和证据可追溯，并持续发现和修复规范、代码与证据的偏离.


Requirements and method sources below are design declarations. They do not assert execution, review, promotion or engineering acceptance.

| Requirement | Function | Conditions | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|
| req_code_evolution | Compare two independently built source-bound code artifacts with one fixed external evaluator | Full public source/tools/generation/runner identities frozen; same cases and budgets | Strict independent cases, no drift, failed/unknown and fixed denominator retained; engineering/selection not connected |
| req_delivery | 文档、报告、安装、分发与维护 | 同一根、显式清单、隐私排除 | 新根构建运行，偏离检出，失败恢复；升级保留独立预期、反例与上一个可用版本 |
| req_engineering | CAD、几何、制造、检验与成本 | NX 原生工具、量纲、公差、工艺证据 | 原生结果分别验收，未知成本不按零 |
| req_harness | 正向 Harness 与逆向经验整理 | 有源输入、明确预算与阶段范围 | 部分失败保留，经验不自动晋升；升级收益不抵消目标、语义或来源偏离 |
| req_knowledge | 书源、供应商知识、检索与原页追溯 | 合法持有、原件身份、提取基线 | 原页可回读，采用条件与来源绑定 |
| req_knowledge_ocr_page5 | Preserve exact source TSV and actual same-owner opaque process provenance in separate domains | Selected source bytes only; hierarchy IDs reference parents while reported box containment is a separate diagnostic; no public receipt authority or neutral execution/engineering truth | Independent20 layered criteria frozen before candidate; oldfixture3/native2 and complete original scope unchanged |
| req_knowledge_page_content4 | Connect selected registered original PDF/index/native page to actual fresh renderer output and neutral decoded image content | Exact selected registered local PDF page and designated tool;public JSON/oldsidecar are not producer authority | Independent24 criteria and original188 PNG/RGB gold;actual188/24 render receipts keep wholePDF/tool/argv/stdio/exit and source before-after;oldnative empty/navigation preserved |
| req_knowledge_registered_ocr6 | Provide generally selected registered physical-page OCR source content to existing same-Project preparation | Explicit6 selects registered document/page/count/SHA, original4 renderer144dpi and source5 tool/config/languages; original5 development page admission preserved | Frozen18 source/process/authority criteria, own actual ggen/build/old regressions and one registered vol2page24 development factory; model/engineering and full scope remain unknown |
| req_native_runtime5_diagnostic_content | Preserve complete bounded loader diagnostic byte order, textual states and required unknowns in generated contracts | Caller supplies explicit declared domain and complete original UTF8 diagnostic bytes; no dispatch or process owner is created | Actual raw three version streams reproduce independent frozen full-line/byte counts; delayed and unrecognized states retained; replay denies changed content/order/domain/unknown qualification; all actual loading/process/source/platform authority remains unknown |
| req_project | 维护对象、条件、证据、决定与变更 | 精确对象和版本身份 | 陈旧或不同来源结论被重审 |
| req_semantic_page_content3 | Provide original page image decoded samples and complete fixed raw TSV content through the existing neutral SourceProvider | Caller supplies exact selected image asset and declared document/physical-page binding, or fixed TSV asset; no OCR/model/native execution authority | Actual original page188 RGB8 pixels match independent pre-parser digest; all raw TSV rows/offsets/confidence retained and adversarial source/framing/resource/replay cases refuse; old native empty/navigation_only/assertions unchanged |
| req_semantic_platform | 将工程本体论代码化：以功能/条件/来源/证据和变更关系组织完整 Semantica Rust 替代；通用能力、生成合同、工程规则与编排共同承担，复用唯一执行 | 锁定oe.7全库/原API/测试及模型、存储、来源和预算；当前按明确profile接续查询、SHACL、规则、数据集与书籍，不删完整目标 | 通用合同分组不反依赖工程；真实ggen、来源绑定、独立输入和错误保留；全360源码、根CLI/server/worker、Explorer和连接器逐项验收；RRSI完整版本对照/试用/反馈/恢复同属必要目标 |
| req_semantic_tsv_source5 | Preserve exact source TSV and actual same-owner opaque process provenance in separate domains | Selected source bytes only; hierarchy IDs reference parents while reported box containment is a separate diagnostic; no public receipt authority or neutral execution/engineering truth | Independent20 layered criteria frozen before candidate; oldfixture3/native2 and complete original scope unchanged |
| req_semantics | 执行本体、查询、约束、规则、版本与治理 | 锁定资产、新内核身份及支持范围 | 固定预期与反例运行；不支持保持未知 |
| req_supplier | 浏览器与供应商资料取得 | 精确账号、观察动作与工程用途 | 取得文件字节核验，账号/原生边界另验 |
| req_understanding | 理解目的、需求、候选与取舍 | 用户自然语言与现有项目上下文 | 来源和条件保留，未知不误报采用 |
| semantic_refinery_original_contracts | Preserve pinned refinery 22 dataclass/public serialization and governed candidate lifecycle in Rust | Same project, source, actor, baseline, evidence, original fixed oracles and state owner; no implicit authority | Actual original behavior comparisons and independent counterexamples; candidate observation never establishes engineering adoption; full19/22 and13494 remain required |
| semantic_typed_models_complete | Preserve the complete pinned106 model/529 field/53 annotation behavior and original manual typed workflow in Rust | Exact original model sources, frozen independent behavior, same shared model budget and authority | Each modeled behavior independently executed; construction versus validation versus engineering adoption separate; unknown original SDK/native domains retained |
